body:
Your order arrives in a plain, sturdy carton without product names or logos on the outside. That is what most customers mean by discreet packaging, and it is how we ship every order. It does not mean the parcel is unlabelled: federal rules require a label on parcels containing vaping products, and adult signature is required on delivery. This guide explains what the outside and the inside of your parcel look like, why the legal label is there, how we protect your details, what to check when you open it, how to store your products and how packaging connects with returns and damage claims. It follows our [shipping policy](/shipping/) and is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Outside the box
The exterior carries a shipping label with your address and our return address. There is no product description, no brand name and no logo on the outside, so the parcel looks like any ordinary shipment. Federal rules require a label on parcels containing vaping products, and the label states that federal law requires the payment of applicable excise taxes and compliance with licensing and tax-stamping obligations. This is a legal requirement for remote vape shipments, not a choice we make, and it applies to every seller. The label is small and factual, and it does not name the products inside.

## Inside the box
Items are packed with padding to reduce damage in transit. Bottles of liquid are sealed and upright where possible, wrapped to protect them from knocks, and devices are cushioned. An invoice with your order ID is included, listing what you ordered, so you can check the contents. If you ordered several products, they are packed together in a single carton where size allows. The packing is designed to survive regional carrier handling, which can involve several hand-offs.

## Why the label matters
The label is part of rules for remote vape shipments, which also require adult signature on delivery and compliance with state and federal tax obligations. Our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) explains these rules in detail. The label also helps the carrier handle the parcel correctly, because it signals that signature is required. Removing or covering the label would be a problem for the carrier and for the delivery.

## Privacy of your details
We only use your information to fulfill the order and contact you. Your name and address appear on the shipping label, because the carrier needs them, and your order details are stored with your order in our systems. The outside of the box never carries product names, and the invoice inside lists the items only for you. Read the [privacy policy](/privacy/) for how we collect, use and protect information, and [why we need your email and phone](/blog/why-we-need-your-email-and-phone/).

## What the carrier sees
The carrier sees the label: the addresses, the adult-signature requirement and the legal statement. The carrier does not see the invoice inside, and the box does not describe its contents. That is the extent of the "discreet" part: it is about not advertising what is inside, not about hiding that the parcel contains a regulated product.

## Opening your parcel
Check the contents against your invoice as soon as you open the parcel. Look for damage to the box, the bottles and the devices. If something is damaged, photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email us, as described in our shipping policy; we will help you reorder damaged items. If something is missing, tell us right away with your order ID and a photo of the invoice and contents. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

### A short checklist when you open it
1. Check the label on the box matches your name and address.
2. Open carefully, keeping the invoice and packing material.
3. Compare each item with the invoice.
4. Look for leaks, dents or cracks.
5. Photograph any problem straight away, before you throw anything away.
6. Contact us with your order ID and the photos.

## Storage after delivery
Keep products away from children and pets and out of heat and direct sunlight. Store e-liquid upright and capped in a cool, dark place, and store devices at room temperature. Do not leave products in a hot car or on a windowsill. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/), [how to store disposable vapes](/blog/how-to-store-disposable-vapes/) and [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/). If you will not use a product for a long time, check its date and use older items first.

## Recycling the packaging
The carton and padding are ordinary packaging materials and can usually be recycled according to your local rules. Remove labels with your address before recycling if you prefer. Batteries and electronic devices should be taken to a collection point. See [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Returns and the original packaging
Our returns policy allows returns within 30 days for unopened items in original packaging, and opened or used products cannot be returned. Keep the original packaging and the invoice until you are sure you will keep an item. Refunds go back through the payment method the payment was received through, less a 15% restocking fee, and you are responsible for shipping the product back to us. Contact us before you return anything so we can provide an RMA form. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/) and the [refund policy](/refunds/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is the packaging completely plain?
The outside is plain, with no product names or logos, but it carries the shipping label and the legal label that federal rules require.

### Can I ask for different packaging?
We use standard packaging for all orders to keep the process consistent and compliant. If you have a specific concern, contact us before you order.

### Will the carrier know what is inside?
The carrier knows the parcel requires adult signature and carries the legal label. The box does not list the products.

### Will the invoice show prices?
The invoice shows your order ID and the items. If you need a different format for your records, contact us.

### Can I have it delivered to a locker or PO box?
Adult signature is required, so delivery must be to a street address where an adult can sign. See [shipping address tips](/blog/shipping-address-tips/).

## Related reading
Read [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) and [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Common concerns about packaging
### Will neighbors or family know what is inside?
The outside does not name the contents or show a logo, so the parcel looks like any ordinary delivery. The legal label is small and factual. Delivery requires a signature from an adult, which a neighbor or family member may notice, but the signature requirement does not reveal the contents either.

### What about the return address?
The return address is our business address at 4908 E McDowell Road, Phoenix, Arizona, without a product description. It is there so that the carrier can return the parcel if delivery fails.

### Can I choose a different shipping name?
Use the name that matches the ID of the person who will sign, because the carrier may compare them. If the name on the order differs from the person receiving, tell us in the order notes.

### Is the invoice inside necessary?
It lists the items and the order ID so that you can check the contents and so that we can help quickly if something is wrong. Keep it until you have checked everything, and until any return window has passed.

### What if the packaging looks damaged on arrival?
Take photos of the outside and inside before you open anything else, and mention the carrier's name and the date. Photos of the box, the items and the invoice give us what we need to help. Then email us with your order ID. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**Why does the carton not mention the shop?** To avoid advertising what is inside on the outside of a parcel that may sit on a doorstep or pass through many hands. The label contains only what is needed for delivery and what the law requires.

**Is the packaging recyclable?** The carton and padding are ordinary materials and can usually be recycled. Follow your local rules.

**Can I request extra padding?** We pack every order to survive regional carrier handling. If you order fragile or high-value items and have a concern, contact us before you order.

**Will the invoice be in the box if I have the order shipped elsewhere?** Yes. The invoice lists the items and order ID, and it goes in every parcel.

### If you are not at home when it arrives
Because adult signature is required, a parcel is not left on the doorstep. The carrier will leave a notice and try again, or hold the parcel for collection depending on its own rules. That means no one will find it unattended, which is part of how the process protects the contents and keeps age-restricted products out of the wrong hands. Follow the instructions on the notice, and have your ID ready when you collect or when the carrier returns.

### Keeping your own records
Keep the invoice, the tracking email and any delivery notices until you are sure you are happy with everything in the parcel. If you ever need to contact us about an item, the order ID on the invoice and the photos you took when you opened the box make it quick for us to help.
